# Fix the regex in new_content - replace bare backslashes with \.
lines = new_content.split('\n')
fixed_lines = []
i = 0
while i < len(lines):
    line = lines[i]
    # Look for pattern: line with just a backslash followed by (?P<...>
    if line.strip() == '\\' and i+1 < len(lines) and '(?P<' in lines[i+1]:
        fixed_lines.append('        \\.' + ' ' * (len(line) - 6))  # Keep same length-ish
        i += 1
    else:
        fixed_lines.append(line)
        i += 1

fixed_content = '\n'.join(fixed_lines)

# Verify the fix
import re
regex_test = re.compile(r"""
        ^
        (?P<major>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        \.
        (?P<minor>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        \.
        (?P<patch>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        (\-(?P<prerelease>
            (?:0|[1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*)
            (\.(?:0|[1-9A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*))*
        ))?
        (\+(?P<build>
            [0-9A-Za-z-]+
            (\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*
        ))?
        $
        """, re.VERBOSE)

# Test
test_versions = ['1.2.3', '1.0.0-rc1', '1.2.3-alpha.1+build.4', '0.0.0', '10.20.30']
for v in test_versions:
    m = regex_test.match(v)
    print(f"{v}: {'MATCH' if m else 'NO MATCH'}")
